name: Louis Chiron
features: olive skin, dark hair, brown eyes, thin mustache, lean build, elegant features, charming expression, well-groomed
bio: Louis Alexandre Chiron was a Monégasque racing driver, considered one of the finest of the pre-war era. He won numerous Grand Prix races driving for Bugatti, Alfa Romeo, and Mercedes-Benz. He remains the oldest driver to compete in a Formula One World Championship race.
